title: feat(ci): deliver the changeset claim re-read onto the pull request (objectui#9140)
body:
Fixes #9140

Director ruling, comment `5682891844` (batch #136 item 2, letter **B**, maintainer 「同意」):
`check-changeset-claims` findings are **delivered, not archived**. On a pull request CI runs the
gate against the PR's merge base and head and, when it names a pending changeset the diff may have
falsified, posts the finding as a comment on that PR — through the channel the Console Performance
Budget report already uses.

⛔ **Report-only did not move.** Exit 0 on findings, not a required context, nothing blocks. Letter
**C** stays fenced, letter **A** stays refused, and the `--audit` census from PR objectui#9410 is
untouched — the coordinate is ⛔ not widened. Delivery changes only *where the finding is read*.

## What landed

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` | `--json FILE` hand-off: this run's finding set, written once, by the run that printed the log |
| `scripts/render-changeset-claims-comment.mjs` | new — renders the comment body from that hand-off |
| `.github/workflows/changeset-presence.yml` | job-level `pull-requests: write`, a render step and a delivery step |
| `scripts/__tests__/render-changeset-claims-comment.test.ts` | new — 20 pins on the rendering |
| `scripts/__tests__/check-changeset-claims.test.ts` | pins on the workflow wiring, the permission shape and the hand-off |
| `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` | the delivery, documented in the section that already owns this gate |

## The three measurements the ruling asked for

**1. The `pull-requests: write` grant is the existing one, ⛔ not a new permission.** It is the
same `GITHUB_TOKEN` scope `performance-budget.yml` posts the budget report with; four other
workflows here hold it too (`labeler.yml`, `changeset-release.yml`, `cross-repo-issue-closer.yml`,
`dependabot-auto-merge.yml`). No new secret, no personal token, no GitHub App, and ⛔ no
`pull_request_target` — pinned by a test.

⚠️ One reading that has to be stated plainly rather than glossed: GitHub scopes `permissions:`
per workflow and per job, so there is no repository-wide grant to inherit and this **is** a new
line in `changeset-presence.yml`. What the ruling fenced — a permission this repository does not
already give a gate job — is not required. It is declared on the `changeset-claims` job alone, so
the declaration gate beside it keeps its read-only token.

**2. "Against the PR's merge base and head" was free.** The gate already resolves its base as the
merge base with the target branch and already accepts an explicit pair; `actions/checkout` on a
`pull_request` event checks out the merge result. Nothing in the tree resolution changed. ⇒ the
"is this a redesign" fork in the dispatch did not open.

**3. The budget report is the channel, and only the channel.** It posts with
`actions/github-script` and `github.rest.issues.createComment` — and it **always creates**: no
marker, no update, one comment per run. So the ruling's *"one comment per PR, updated in place,
⛔ not stacked"* is an addition here, ⛔ not a copy. What is reused is the channel, the retry and
`continue-on-error` shape, and the render-in-a-script-so-it-can-be-unit-tested discipline.

## ⛔ Why the marker is plain text and not a hidden HTML comment

The usual shape for "find my own previous comment" is a hidden HTML-comment marker. In this
repository that shape is **measured not to work**: AGENTS.md records that GitHub deletes tag-shaped
fragments from a stored body, that backticks and fenced blocks do not protect them, and that an
HTML comment alone on the first line is eaten with them.

A marker that vanishes does not degrade gracefully — every re-run fails to find its predecessor and
posts again, which is exactly the stacking the ruling forbids. So the marker is the first line of
the body in plain text, it renders visibly, and the workflow reads it **off the body it is about to
post** rather than carrying a second copy.

Same sanitizer, second half: the comment quotes a paragraph of somebody else's changeset, and that
prose routinely names components in angle brackets. Those spans are rewritten to
`ANGLE-BRACKETS(name)` on the way out, and the comment says so — but only when the rewrite actually
fired, so a standing disclaimer never teaches readers to discount a verbatim quote.

## The probe commits, and why they are here

This pull request's own diff names no file any of the 1,597 pending changesets spells, so the new
step would correctly post nothing — and the ruling requires one *measured* delivery, not an
assertion. Commit 2 is a one-shot probe: six comment lines appended to
`scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, a file two pending changesets name in backticks. Commit 3
reverts it, and the revert is itself the second measurement — the same comment updated in place to
its resolved state, ⛔ not a second comment.

⇒ The delivered comment on this pull request is the measurement. The run-by-run reading (comment
id, comment count per leg) is in the report comment on issue objectui#9140; this body is written
once and ⛔ not edited afterwards, because a `PATCH` here drops the session reference from the
footer and appends a second one.

## Local verification

- `npx vitest run` over the seven test files that read a file this diff touches — **288 passed**,
  including the 59 across the two files that own this gate.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0; `--listFiles` confirms both new files are in that program
  (⛔ not excluded as tests).
- `pnpm lint:root` exit 0, 0 errors.
- 12 derived gates exit 0, among them `check:changeset-claims`, `check:required-check-set`,
  `check:action-ref-convention`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:unreferenced-sources`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` — **NOT GOVERNED**, 4 paths, none matched.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` — no changeset owed; nothing published moved, which
  is the measurement behind `skip-changeset` rather than a judgement call.
- `check:doc-snippets` and `check:doc-examples` are **NOT MEASURED** locally: both refuse to run
  without a full package build (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`), and this diff adds no fenced snippet.
  Declared to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- `render-budget-comment.mjs` stacks one comment per run on every `packages/**` pull request, with
  no marker and no in-place update. Out of scope here and ⛔ not filed: noted only, since this
  change now puts a working in-place mechanism next to it in the same repository.
- `runGate` in `check-changeset-claims.test.ts` dropped stderr on the success path, so a harness
  reading a green run could not see a warning the gate prints. Fixed in place — it is the same
  defect class as this card and one line of the same file.
